# Atlas AI

> Atlas AI is the artificial intelligence practice of Atlas Technology Solutions
> (atlascarolina.com), an Apple-certified IT consultancy and managed service
> provider based in Davidson, NC, serving Charlotte and the Carolinas since 2018.

## What Atlas AI offers

- AI Integrations: connecting AI to the tools and software systems a business
  already uses (email, ticketing, CRM, documents, scheduling).
- Agentic Workflows: designing and building AI agents that execute multi-step
  business processes with human checkpoints.
- AI Training: hands-on workshops and leadership briefings for teams adopting AI.
- AI Security: data governance, access control, vendor evaluation, and safe AI
  deployment, backed by an established cybersecurity practice.
- AI Policy Creation: practical acceptable-use and governance policies for AI
  in the workplace.
- Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity (via Atlas Technology Solutions).
- Apple and Jamf device management: certified Jamf MSP, Integrator, and
  Services Partner; member of the Apple Consultants Network.
